hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/caledonia-state-park/stay (Chinquapin Hill '18 full-hookup sites', Hosack Run '17 full-hookup sites') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880303 (43 public sites list 50-amp, 14 list 30-amp; the 33 Full-Hookup sites list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 157 campsites on the booking site (100 Modern Non-Electric, 24 Modern Electric, 33 Full-Hookup) in two campgrounds, Chinquapin Hill and Hosack Run, besides 5 group tenting sites and a rental house; DCNR names 18 + 17 full-hookup sites. Listed max vehicle lengths run 10 to 70 ft, about 45 sites take 40 ft or more; two are pull-through (127 Chinquapin West, 164 Hosack Run). Pets are not allowed in Chinquapin Hill; every Hosack Run site is pet-friendly.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/caledonia-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880303 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/caledonia-state-park/stay ('Both campgrounds have drinking water, showers, flush toilets, and sanitary dump stations'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). Check-in and check-out 3 p.m.

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/caledonia-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880303 (Booking Window for Full-Hookup, Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season already manual (day before trout season to end of deer season). Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 33 full-hookup sites, 157 campsites to 70 ft with two pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/drinking water/dump. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
